game.reason: Game is a client engine/runtime with State replication bindings, not a missing standalone infera-game HTTP service.

panel.reason: Static Vite/React frontend served by Nginx. /api/ and /admin/ proxy to Agentic; /health is static Nginx health, not Agentic readiness. Proxy auth/request and UI compatibility remain separate gates, no duplicate business service/package.

website.reason: Prerendered marketing website served by Nginx. Explicit plans/currency/app-release/play APIs proxy to Agentic after identity header stripping; dashboard/admin/login redirect to panel. Static /health is process health. Separate UI and proxy tests remain required.

worker.reason: Agentic workspace infera_worker binary, outbound registration/heartbeat/job long-poll/progress/leases. Pairing/execution/billing API authority is Agentic. LAN port8765 diagnostic responds with worker name, not project administration or instruction/memory authority; no duplicate business package.

android-app.reason: Observed deployment is external traefik/whoami:latest with no Infera catalog source; diagnostic placeholder, not evidence of a completed Android application or another business SDK. Keep explicitly classified; image provenance/release ownership remain unverified.

Service/infera-faiber.reason: Legacy Node control plane superseded by infera-control; retained as historical material.

runtime_inventory.meaning: Read-only serving Control catalog and all-namespace deployment inventory. Names require explicit business-service or source-backed runtime ownership classification; this alone does not certify any capability.
